changes: Keeps every durably owned non-terminal download visible through transient SAB Queue/History slot omissions instead of dropping the card after a three-second presentation window.

Requires fresh Queue and History absence through the existing ownership-retention window before stale non-terminal ownership can be released, while explicit Remove/Cancel tombstones and terminal History remain authoritative.
Adds Downloads visibility-continuity telemetry for bridged cards, queued bridges, open bridges, longest observed gap, and SAB omission events.
Reduces localhost Queue/History read pressure with longer shared live snapshots while preserving the 250 ms browser refresh cadence.
Prevents temporary tray/user-session launch failures from allocating unnecessary new SAB admin-vN generations, and makes SAB startup/User-Agent labels follow the current adapter version.
Preserves v3.6.27 runtime adapter identity validation plus v3.6.26 verified Remove and bulk Failed cleanup behavior.
regression_guards: Explicit Remove/Cancel tombstones and verified terminal SAB state remain authoritative and cannot be overridden by visibility continuity.
Stale non-terminal ownership remains bounded by the existing fresh Queue/History retention window; continuity does not create permanent ghost downloads.
v3.6.27 adapter identity validation remains intact.
v3.6.26 verified Remove and bulk Failed cleanup behavior remains intact.
v3.6.25 Automation backlog/Smart Import reliability and v3.6.24 durable Download Statistics remain intact.
Discover/TMDB, Metadata Server v0.3.3 integration, installer/updater behavior, provider settings, and user data preservation are otherwise unchanged.
name: Downloads Continuity & SAB Recovery Hardening
